headline: South Africa revises GDP figures, increasing nominal level by 5.1%
summary: Statistics South Africa has rebased and benchmarked GDP data, resulting in a 5.1% increase in the measured level of nominal GDP, equivalent to R393 billion.
why: GDP revisions can alter fiscal ratios, such as debt-to-GDP, potentially impacting sovereign credit ratings and investor sentiment.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Higher nominal GDP improves key fiscal ratios.
